WITH admin_pwd AS ( SELECT ac.password_hash, ac.password_algo FROM auth.users u JOIN auth.auth_credentials ac ON ac.user_id = u.id WHERE u.username = 'admintest' LIMIT 1 ) INSERT INTO auth.auth_credentials (id, user_id, password_hash, password_algo, created_at, updated_at) SELECT pairs.cred_id, pairs.user_id, ap.password_hash, ap.password_algo, now(), now() FROM ( VALUES ('cf2c8386-30b3-59f2-9606-6b8c4bf32aa6'::uuid, '7250db67-a626-5960-8314-4eb38ad1f9cb'::uuid), ('9eb18387-b12a-56ba-8b06-e9e65b97a6f1'::uuid, '92c1b8ab-168f-5ca3-9414-e64ffc8a6d8b'::uuid), ('1b94775d-34f7-53e9-b79b-8d41f4dc53aa'::uuid, 'e3d81eb1-230f-561b-a70e-a86db96ade66'::uuid), ('f7cffc0d-c1e4-577b-9778-136bdc355ece'::uuid, '3d892715-8d0b-5b3b-bd83-491ecb362adf'::uuid), ('0fa41e46-62a6-5bcd-8067-2a7be1641678'::uuid, '183ee631-5184-56dd-9893-d368cbe12a34'::uuid), ('a7232f53-4d70-5925-8163-b3132086a7cf'::uuid, '181629c1-c97a-5a58-bbdd-5d037a00562c'::uuid) ) AS pairs(cred_id, user_id) CROSS JOIN admin_pwd ap WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.auth_credentials WHERE id = pairs.cred_id);
INSERT INTO public.user_profile_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT u.id, r.id FROM auth.users u JOIN auth.roles r ON r.name = 'user' WHERE u.id IN ( '7250db67-a626-5960-8314-4eb38ad1f9cb'::uuid, '92c1b8ab-168f-5ca3-9414-e64ffc8a6d8b'::uuid, '1b94775d-34f7-53e9-b79b-8d41f4dc53aa'::uuid, 'f7cffc0d-c1e4-577b-9778-136bdc355ece'::uuid, '0fa41e46-62a6-5bcd-8067-2a7be1641678'::uuid, 'a7232f53-4d70-5925-8163-b3132086a7cf'::uuid ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_profile_roles upr WHERE upr.user_id = u.id AND upr.role_id = r.id );
